import json,sys,base64,re
def walk(p):
    out=[]
    b=p.get('body',{}).get('data')
    if b and p.get('mimeType','').startswith('text/plain'):
        out.append(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(b+'==').decode('utf-8','replace'))
    for c in p.get('parts',[]) or []:
        out+=walk(c)
    if not out and b:
        out.append(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(b+'==').decode('utf-8','replace'))
    return out
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
d=json.loads(d['result']) if 'result' in d else d
lim=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 1500
for m in d.get('messages',[]):

    print('=====',h.get('Date'),'|',h.get('From'),'->',h.get('To'),'|',h.get('Subject'))

    lines=[l for l in txt.splitlines() if not l.startswith('>')]
    t='\n'.join(lines)
